{"policy":"permit (
    principal is Person,
    action == Action::"executeSwitching",
    resource is SwitchingOrder
)
when {
    (principal.roles.contains(Role::"Operator") ||
     principal.roles.contains(Role::"ControlRoomOperator")) &&
    resource.status == SwitchingOrderStatus::"Authorized" &&
    context.currentTime.durationSince(resource.scheduledStart).toMilliseconds() >= 0 &&
    resource.scheduledEnd.durationSince(context.currentTime).toMilliseconds() >= 0 &&
    (!resource.requiresControlRoomHandling ||
     principal.roles.contains(Role::"ControlRoomOperator"))
};"}
